name: web-tab-navigation-variants-pill-segment-and-underline-with-icons
title: Three tab bar styles for Profile, Security and Notifications: raised white pill in a grey track, soft-filled pill and underline
whatItIs: A white board with three rows of the same three tabs with line icons: a grey rounded track with the active Profile in a white raised pill, a version where the active tab has a soft grey fill, and a version with a black underline under the active tab on a hairline.
whatItMeans: Systematic and calm; showing three active-state treatments side by side helps choose one.
techniques: Show the same tabs in multiple styles.
Mark active with a raised pill, tint or underline.

vocabulary.definition: Tabs inside a shared rounded track.
Tabs marked by a line beneath the active one.
An active tab shown as a white capsule with a shadow.
A tab combining an icon and a label.
